Hi @FirstName@,
Thank you for your interest in trying SiriusXM Business.
Unfortunately, we weren't able to approve your free trial because some of the information submitted couldn't be verified.
Before submitting another request, please make sure:
The request is for a legitimate business.
The business name, phone number, and email address are accurate.
The business hasn't already received a free trial.
Once you've updated your information, you're welcome to submit a new request.
If you have any questions or believe this was an error, our team is happy to help.
Call us Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM ET at 586-978-4214. You can also reach us by email at CustomerService@dm-us.com.
Thank you!
The Dynamic Media Team
